value.rationale: The exact all-step cancellation of split variances for expected area is a nontrivial structural observable complementary to Lyapunov typical-shape studies. It gives a complete arbitrary-polygon spectral law and distribution-free regular-polygon diffusive decay and identifies why cross-edge decorrelation matters. This is not an arbitrary finite sample or a rephrasing of the source theorems.
